required_fixes: RF-1-CLAIM-CEILING-OVERSTATED: result.json.metrics.decision_text_faithful='PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED' and report.md section 5 ('permanent bounded drop ... no re-admission, no further L-sweeps') exceed what the packet's own evidence supports. The AUDIT recomputation (AF-6) shows the entire measured reuse latency deficit, and 2x-7x more, is produced by the single per-phase delta S-REGISTRY-BUILD (reuse median 1.4866ms vs cold median 0.0379ms = 39.2x over 36 trials), whose origin in the frozen carrier is the v2 Arm.__init__ loop `for m in mech_dicts.values(): self.registry.upsert(Mechanism(**m))` (research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-38244432934/raw_evidence/runner_delta_repair_reuse_v2.py:341-353) issuing one full JSONL read+rewrite per inherited mechanism on a fresh file (5 sequential cycles for reuse vs 1 for cold). Equalizing only that phase delta from packet-raw medians moves all six gated ratios below 1.00 (M-LATENCY-R-L3 1.1359/1.0374/1.1187 -> 0.8717/0.7769/0.8604; M-LATENCY-R-L2 1.2463/1.1521/1.2350 -> 0.9564/0.8628/0.9499). The maximum justified ceiling is an implementation-bounded negative that LOCALIZES a removable carrier tax, not a permanent product-story drop that closes the question. Correct decision_text_faithful, product_consequence application and report.md section 5 before any verdict adopts it.

RF-2-ATTRIBUTION-ANSWER-IS-A-TIE-NOT-A-DETERMINATION: result.json.metrics.attribution_answer='ATTRIBUTED-S-REGISTRY-BUILD' is selected by frozen-driver iteration order over PHASE_KEYS (raw_evidence/runner_delta_repair_scaffold_v4.py:646-689, `if votes[key] >= 2 and attributed is None`), not by evidence strength. AUDIT recomputation of shares_of_excess from raw trials gives three distinct components clearing the frozen >=0.50 share on >=2/3 classes: S-REGISTRY-BUILD (1.932/6.889/2.206, 3/3), S-PROBE (0.855/2.991/0.919, 3/3) and S-REPAIR-SIGNAL (0.757/0.208/0.870, 2/3); the aggregated 'REGISTRY' bucket also clears. Report attribution_answer as a tie set {S-REGISTRY-BUILD, S-PROBE, S-REPAIR-SIGNAL} resolved by first-match order, and record that the shares are non-decomposable (computed against a NET excess that already nets ~2.54ms of cold-side savings on P1), so no single component 'accounts for' the excess in an additive sense.

RF-3-MANDATORY-METRIC-NULLS-DESPITE-AVAILABLE-VALUES: result.json.metrics.per_class.*.M-SCAFFOLD-REUSE and .M-SCAFFOLD-COLD-L3 are recorded as null on all three classes, but raw_evidence/scored_run.json#per_class.* records M-SCAFFOLD-REUSE=120 and M-SCAFFOLD-COLD-L3=36 per class, and M-SP5-RATIO-L2=1.2857142857142858 / M-SP5-RATIO-L3=1.2272727272727273 are reported in the same object although they are computed directly from those two values. research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 1 forbids encoding an available value as null. Replace both nulls with the measured integers.

RF-4-METRIC-IDENTIFIER-DRIFT: result.json renames raw identifiers M-EQUIV-MATCH-N and M-EQUIV-MATCH-DEN into a synthetic result.json-only key 'M-EQUIV-MATCH' with value '12/12'. research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 1 requires stable metric identity so downstream stages can refer to the same objects. Emit M-EQUIV-MATCH-N=12 and M-EQUIV-MATCH-DEN=12 under their raw names.

RF-5-CONTAMINATION-DENOMINATOR-MISCOUNT: result.json.observations states 'contamination count 0/24 unaffected probes per class'. raw_evidence/scored_run.json#trials[*].unaffected_n is 4 (RESOURCES has 5 entries, minus the target), so the correct denominator is 4 x 12 = 48 in-support unaffected probes per class (144 across all 36 trials), consistent with the parent packet's audit AF-9 'contamination 0/144'. M-CONTAMINATION-RATE=0.0 is unaffected; the reported denominator is not.

RF-6-DRIVER-GATE-DEFECT: the frozen driver evaluates three must-pass upper-bound gates as `(m or 1.0) > 0.10` (raw_evidence/runner_delta_repair_scaffold_v4.py:885, 889, 893) and a fourth as `(m or 99) > 1` (line 895). In Python a legitimately observed 0.0 is falsy and is replaced by the default, so perfect must-fail-control behaviour spuriously trips MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This must be repaired to explicit `is None` checks in the next DESIGN revision; the driver is byte-bound by CANONICAL-RUNNER-V4-SHA256 and may not be edited in this packet, so the fix belongs to the successor design, not to this experiment.

RF-7-DESIGN-PREFLIGHT-COVERAGE-GAP: the defect in RF-6 was reachable before freeze and was not detected. raw_evidence/preflight_reachability.json exercises only synthetic_reachability_probe_v4 -> cost_verdict_v4 / aggregate_v4 (all 4+4 branches live); it never drives the gate block in main() with the boundary values (0.0) that the must-fail controls are designed to produce. spec.freeze_eligibility.decision_rule_reachability.status=PASS therefore overstates gate reachability. The successor DESIGN must probe the gate expressions at 0.0/0.10 and 1/0.10 boundaries.

RF-8-FREEZE-ARTIFACT-COMPLETENESS: src/spider/__init__.py is executed in the driver's import closure (it re-exports SpiderKernel from .kernel, which the driver imports) but is absent from spec.freeze_artifacts and from freeze.json.artifact_hashes, while spec.freeze_eligibility.freeze_artifacts_bound asserts 'no other mutable imports exist'. This is design_review.json#nonblocking_findings[NB1], already identified pre-freeze and still unbound at EXECUTE. Add it to the successor freeze set or soften the closure claim.

RF-9-VACUOUS-CONTROL-NOT-DISCLOSED: B-NO-REPAIR is reported PASS in result.json.controls with 'M-NOREPAIR-SUCCESS 0.0 ... guard fired 36/36', but the gate it backs (V6 'success <= 0.10 -> else MEASUREMENT_INVALID') can never trip: pinned v2 run_norepair hardcodes the constant success=False return (runner_delta_repair_reuse_v2.py:665). This is design_review.json#nonblocking_findings[NB2]. The control contributes only its guard-fired diagnostic and the producer did not record its vacuity in result.json.validity_notes, so a downstream reader may credit it as a live must-fail control.

RF-10-MANDATE-ASYMMETRY-ACTUALLY-FIRED: design_review.json#nonblocking_findings[NB5] warned that a single near-1.00 latency ratio converts to PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED with no further L-sweeps while bootstrap CIs are reported but not gated. In this run the narrowest ratio did exactly that: M-LATENCY-R-L3 = 1.0373822814820506 and M-LATENCY-R-L3-NOARG = 1.0234817873434012 on P2-STRUCTURE (CI95 lower bound 1.0233003314931735) are what carry P2 into the permanent-drop tier. Any DIRECTOR adoption must state that the 'permanent' label is triggered by the narrowest of six ratios, not by a uniform margin.

The frozen executable's terminal state is status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID with 9 invalid_reasons ('perturbation-does-not-bite', 'abstention-control-fired', 'contamination-above-bar' x3 classes), while result.json reports status=COMPLETE / decision_text_faithful=PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED. I adjudicated this against the binding text rather than against either party's summary. The frozen spec.decision_rule and measurement_validity V4/V6/V8 state the gates semantically ('success <= 0.10', 'contamination <= 0.10'); the observed values are exactly 0.0 on all three classes for M-LITERAL-SUCCESS, M-NOREPAIR-SUCCESS and M-CONTAMINATION-RATE, which satisfy those textual bars. The driver's `(0.0 or 1.0) > 0.10` is a Python-falsiness defect, and the driver's own cost classifier path (v2.functional_ok, direct comparisons) returns PRICED-DEFICIT x3. On the substance no named section-8 validity gate fails, so the text-faithful COMPLETE reading is defensible and I do not invalidate the packet on this ground. I record two reservations rather than acceptance-as-is: (i) the override converts a fail-safe MEASUREMENT_INVALID into a negative FALSIFIES, which is the direction requiring the most scrutiny, and it was made after outcomes were visible; (ii) the divergence is a DESIGN-reachable defect that the frozen reachability probe never exercised (RF-7). The producer's handling is otherwise exemplary: the raw stdout is preserved verbatim in result.json.metrics.driver_emitted and never overwritten. Critically, the scientific direction does not depend on this override -- the latency deficit is a separate, independently robust surface.

The one genuinely discriminating surface in this packet survives the attacks available to me. (a) Order confound: the deficit is present in BOTH parity orders, not an artifact of running the reuse arm first (P1 R_L3 1.1385 reuse-first vs 1.1210 cold-first; P2 1.0435 vs 1.0344; P3 1.1479 vs 1.1072; 6/6 per class as preregistered). (b) Paired signs: reuse slower than cold-L3 in 35/36 and than cold-L2 in 35/36 individual trials (the single exception is the P3-L3 trial the producer flagged). (c) The disclosed S-ARG deepcopy-operand asymmetry is genuinely neutralized by the v3-exact NOARG boundary and the deficit survives it: the lowest NOARG ratio is 1.0234817873434012 (P2-L3), so this is not a deepcopy artifact. (d) Closure is tight (|S-MISC|/episode median 0.0039-0.0065 against a 0.20 bar), so the phase decomposition reconstructs both episodes and the attribution arithmetic is internally consistent. (e) V-EQUIV holds on BOTH arms, not only the reuse side the driver scored: I recomputed warmup_cold_shipped == shipped sum of cold_cost on 36/36 trials as well as warmup_reuse_shipped 36/36, so the v4 reimplementation's discrete projection is faithful to the pinned v2 functions.

H4's criterion ('component X ATTRIBUTED iff its median delta >= 0.50 x median episode gap on >=2/3 classes') is non-discriminating on this data and the frozen first-match order, not the evidence, selects the reported answer. Recomputed shares_of_excess (reuse-minus-coldL3 phase-median delta / median episode gap): S-REGISTRY-BUILD 1.932/6.889/2.206, S-PROBE 0.855/2.991/0.919, S-REPAIR-SIGNAL 0.757/0.208/0.870, S-REGISTRY-WRITE 0.409/1.411/0.488, S-ARG 0.105/0.376/0.120, S-REGISTRY-SCAN 0.113/0.407/0.130, S-POST-VERIFY 0.133/0.464/0.156, S-GUARD 0.001/0.514/0.001, S-CHARGE 0.004/0.012/0.004; negative (cold-side savings) S-EXECUTE -0.480/-1.777/-0.593, S-OBSERVE -2.041/-7.337/-2.328, S-DISCOVERY -0.689/-2.457/-0.745, S-DISTILL -0.180/-0.698/-0.215. Three components clear the bar on >=2/3 classes and two clear it on 3/3. The shares exceed 1.0 because the denominator is a NET excess (0.7503/0.2094/0.6557 ms) that already nets ~2.54ms of cold-side savings on P1, so the metric is not a decomposition and cannot single out a cause. The producer disclosed this honestly in result.json.unresolved[2] and report.md section 3; the defect is that attribution_answer is nevertheless published as a single value. The mandate's question 'which uncounted episode-scaffolding component accounts for the excess' is therefore answered only as 'reuse-side scaffolding in aggregate (~3.23ms gross) net of cold-side savings (~2.54ms)', with registry materialization the single largest term.

This is the decisive audit finding. S-REGISTRY-BUILD is 1.4866ms median for the reuse arm and 0.0379ms for the cold arm across all 36 trials (39.2x); S-REGISTRY-WRITE is 0.4268ms vs 0.1234ms (3.5x); S-REGISTRY-SCAN is 0.0851ms vs 0.0000ms. The cause is in the pinned carrier, not in reuse semantics: v2.Arm.__init__ (research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-38244432934/raw_evidence/runner_delta_repair_reuse_v2.py:341-353) materializes the registry by calling MechanismRegistry.upsert once PER MECHANISM, and upsert performs a full read-all plus write-all of the JSONL file (src/spider/registry.py:28-32). The reuse arm carries 5 inherited mechanisms (Arm built from the full mech_dicts) and executes only the one for the target resource, so it pays 5 sequential read+rewrite cycles plus a registry scan it does not need; the cold arm starts from `Arm({}, ...)` and performs 1 upsert. Equalizing ONLY the S-REGISTRY-BUILD phase delta using packet-raw per-trial values flips all six gated ratios below 1.00 (R_L3 0.8717/0.7769/0.8604; R_L2 0.9564/0.8628/0.9499); equalizing all registry phases gives R_L3 0.8015/0.7086/0.7871. Consequence: the wall-clock deficit that drives PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED is an O(n) file-rewrite artifact of the frozen harness carrier, is removable by a one-line change (a single bulk replace, or registering only the target mechanism), and scales adversarially with inheritance breadth. It does not license a permanent product-story drop. Caveat stated honestly: these are medians of components subtracted from medians of totals (not additive; residual ~0.06ms from median non-additivity plus |S-MISC|), they are a diagnostic decomposition of packet-raw data, not a re-measurement, and they are NOT a preregistered counterfactual; they bound what the evidence can support, they do not establish a win.

B-COLD is live and its nominals pin exactly (V-DRIFT-COLD holds), but as a product-economics comparator it is weak in a specific, structural way, and the packet decides a C-PRODUCT-ECON admission question without addressing it. (a) Recurrence is fixed at h(N)=1 by construction: one reuse episode is compared to one cold episode. Reuse's entire economic case is amortization across recurrences; there is no recurrence loop and no amortization denominator anywhere in the packet. (b) The 5-mechanism learning cost is paid OUTSIDE the timed window in both arms (v2.make_mech_dicts at runner_delta_repair_scaffold_v4.py:241, before t0), so both arms are handed pre-learned knowledge and only the marginal episode is priced. (c) Cold derivation here is one distill_parameterized over 3 local JSON GETs producing ONE mechanism that covers all 5 task ids, whereas the reuse arm inherits 5 per-resource mechanisms and uses 1. Cold is therefore the cheapest available cold path by construction, and the reuse arm is the most expensive available reuse path by construction. (d) The shipped 4-field premise (M-SHIPPED-REUSE 204 vs 216/228) is a deterministic identity with zero empirical variance, exactly the parent audit AF-3 failure mode relocated from a fitted weight to a fixed one; it is disclosed as a premise and correctly carries no evidential weight, which means the entire decision rides on the latency surface examined in AF-6.

The measured excess (0.2094-0.7503 ms median) is smaller than a single local HTTP GET on this substrate (S-OBSERVE median 510.2us per fetch) and 2-3 orders of magnitude below real web navigation or network economics. The decision rule nonetheless routes a permanent C-PRODUCT-ECON product-story drop through this single-vantage localhost ThreadingHTTPServer measurement. No transfer to real web, browser/network economics, production carriers or external agent harnesses is licensed. Producer bounds this correctly in result.json.unresolved[1] and validity_notes; the defect is that the frozen product_consequence_negative lets the permanent-drop wording outrun that bound.

M-MODEL-CALLS-TOTAL=0 and M-MODEL-TOKENS-TOTAL=0 are read from kernel counters (per-trial model_calls/model_tokens summed over the reuse, conservative, legacy, cold-L3 and cold-L2 arms) and are structurally zero: no model endpoint exists on this substrate (V2-SUBSTRATE_ISOLATION). The mandate's 'model calls/tokens' component of an end-to-end counter is therefore absent, and this packet decides a product-economics claim with the largest cost term unmeasured. The producer records this correctly as UNSATISFIABLE-with-blocker in result.json.metrics (b3_model_economics), unresolved[0] and validity_notes, and does not convert the structural zero into evidence. The parent packet's AF-6 carry-forward is honoured.

No target leakage found. Each Arm writes to a unique path `_RUN_DIR/reg-<tag>-<seq>.jsonl` (v2 Arm._seq), so no registry state crosses arms or trials; cold arms always start from `Arm({}, ...)` and never receive the treatment's cached tokens. write_set_max = 1 on 36/36 trials (only the perturbed target mechanism changed). Contamination is measured only on genuinely unaffected resources with the in-support probe id 14 (TASK_IDS[0]); the out-of-support probe was confirmed degenerate in raw_evidence/preflight_liveness.json (out_of_support_probe_degenerate=true), so the F1 instrumentation defect the parent packet repaired has not recurred. Perturbation retention is verified post-warmup on every trial (retention_ok 36/36), so warmups did not heal the perturbation and the treatment was not silently trivialized. NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR fires 4/4 on every trial, confirming the instrument is sensitive; M-OVERBROAD-CONTAMINATION-N = 4.0 is a per-trial COUNT of broken unaffected resources (0-4), not a 0-1 rate, carried under the producer identifier per parent AF-10.

Recomputed from raw trials: bank_n 36 (sensitivity 36/36 = 1.0), M-CERT-FRESH-N 36, held-out n 12 on seeds SEED4+50000+1000*(ci+1)+k disjoint from the scored bank (sensitivity 12/12 = 1.0, 0 false accepts), M-CERT-SPECIFICITY pooled 38/38 = 1.0, M-CERT-SPECIFICITY-NC 1.0, certificate_complete = true. Boundary labels are honest: BND-REQUIRED-PATHS and BND-THRESHOLD are DERIVED (not measured) and only BND-PROBE-BUDGET is MEASURED, at the single fused probe id 14. Two limits must travel with this deliverable: (i) the certificate's ground truth is stale-by-construction before the guard runs and fresh-by-pre-perturbation, so it certifies guard wiring on this bank rather than real-world probe coverage; (ii) detection is measured at exactly one probe id per episode, which is the budget-sparse boundary the mandate asked about, so the certificate bounds rather than closes B11. The producer states this in report.md section 4 and does not overclaim.

report.md does not exceed result.json and matches it at every checked number (ratios, medians, CIs, closure, certificate counts, attribution deltas, legacy 1.1111). It goes further than required in disclosing VN-DRIVER-OR-DEFAULT in section 1 with the raw stdout preserved, in naming S-PROBE and S-REPAIR-SIGNAL as co-qualifying attribution components in section 3, in naming S-ARG as the disclosed asymmetry and showing the deficit survives its removal, and in pointing AUDIT at the single adjudication point. No measurement exists only in the report. The defects found in this audit (RF-3, RF-4, RF-5) are transcription slips in result.json rather than concealment, and the producer explicitly asks for the driver-idiom question to be adjudicated by AUDIT/DIRECTOR rather than self-repaired.

What is justified about the economics is strictly implementation-bounded and NOT a permanent product-story drop: (a) on the pinned v2 carrier, a single reuse episode is 1.0235x-1.2463x the wall-clock of the corresponding cold episode on both frozen timed boundaries and both L, with 35/36 per-trial signs and every bootstrap CI95 above 1.00; (b) that deficit is more than fully accounted for by reuse-side registry materialization -- S-REGISTRY-BUILD alone carries a share of 1.93/6.89/2.21 of the median episode gap and originates in Arm.__init__ performing one full JSONL read+rewrite per inherited mechanism (5 for reuse vs 1 for cold, 39.2x), of which 4 of 5 mechanisms are never used in the episode; (c) equalizing only that one phase, using packet-raw medians, moves all six gated ratios below 1.00. The maximum justified reading is therefore: as currently implemented, reuse-based localized repair pays a removable, inheritance-breadth-scaled registry-materialization tax that fully accounts for its measured deficit; the packet does NOT establish that reuse-based localized repair is permanently unprofitable, and it does NOT re-admit it either.
